```{r script setup ,message=FALSE, echo=F}
# Script setup
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(data.table)
library(dtplyr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)


base_font_size <- 16
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = base_font_size))
theme_update(
  axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = base_font_size, face = "plain"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size, face = "plain"),
  axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
  legend.title = element_text(size = base_font_size, face = "plain"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = base_font_size, face = "plain"),
  plot.tag = element_text(size = base_font_size, face = "plain"),
  plot.title.position = "plot"
)

fig1_caption <- paste(
  "\\textbf{Genomic and transcriptomic diversity across maize subpopulations.}",
  "(\\textbf{A}) Principal component analysis of genome-wide genetic variants, coloured by subpopulation.",
  "(\\textbf{B}) Canonical correlation analysis relating genetic and gene-expression variation.",
  "(\\textbf{C}) Distribution of the proportion of flowering-time-corrected gene-expression variance explained by subpopulation.",
  "(\\textbf{D}) Nucleotide diversity ($\\pi$) across subpopulations.",
  "(\\textbf{E}) Distribution of the coefficient of variation of gene expression across subpopulations.",
  "Tropical, broad-origin, mixed, stiff-stalk (SS), non-stiff-stalk (NSS), and Iodent (IDT) lines are shown throughout."
)

fig2_caption <- paste(
  "\\textbf{Fine-mapping architecture and a multi-variant eQTL example.}",
  "(\\textbf{A}) Number of credible causal sets per eGene.",
  "(\\textbf{B}) Relationship between the number of variants in a cis window and the number of credible sets.",
  "(\\textbf{C}) Distribution of allelic fold changes (aFCs) for eQTNs; dashed lines indicate $\\log_2$ aFC values of $-2$ and $2$.",
  "(\\textbf{D}) Enrichment of fine-mapped variants by distance from the target-gene transcription start site.",
  "(\\textbf{E}) Narrow-sense heritability by number of credible sets.",
  "(\\textbf{F}) Agreement between single-variant and multiple-variant eQTL-model $R^2$ values.",
  "(\\textbf{G--H}) Local association signal and gene track for PSBS (Zm00001eb146510), with credible-set lead variants highlighted.",
  "(\\textbf{I}) Expression across the most frequent three-SNP genotype haplotypes."
)

fig3_caption <- paste(
  "\\textbf{Fine-mapped eQTL enrichment across genomic, tissue-specific, and functional annotations.}",
  "(\\textbf{A}) Fold enrichment of fine-mapped eQTLs across genomic features, with the proportion of eQTLs assigned to each feature shown at right.",
  "(\\textbf{B}) Fold enrichment and eQTL proportion by leaf and ear expression specificity.",
  "(\\textbf{C}) Functional-category enrichment of fine-mapped eQTLs using leaf-ATAC-matched and standard matched controls; bars show the proportion of eQTLs in each category."
)

fig4_caption <- paste(
  "\\textbf{Fine-mapped eQTL effect sizes, population differentiation, and a Zm00001eb392880 example.}",
  "(\\textbf{A}) Absolute aFC by minor-allele-frequency bin.",
  "(\\textbf{B}) Absolute aFC for genes in the top decile of positive GERP scores and all other genes.",
  "(\\textbf{C}) Distribution of credible-set counts for the same gene groups.",
  "(\\textbf{D}) $F_{ST}$ across adjusted-expression-significance deciles for five population comparisons.",
  "(\\textbf{E}) Zm00001eb392880 expression across Tropical, NSS, SS, and Iodent lines.",
  "(\\textbf{F--G}) Local eQTL association signal and gene track, with fine-mapped credible-set variants highlighted.",
  "(\\textbf{H}) Major and alternative allele frequencies of fine-mapped variants across subpopulations.",
  "(\\textbf{I}) Expression across the four most frequent fine-mapped-variant haplotypes."
)
```
